request.tone: wonder and gentle suspense; peril moderate, scariness mild, violence none
request.note: catalog book, hand-authored; no request exists

pitch.hero: Maya, a girl exploring the sea caves under her aunt's lighthouse with her dog Biscuit
pitch.want: to follow one of three echoing caves and find what makes its sound
pitch.obstacle: the tide returns in about an hour and will seal the cave mouths; slippery rock, rising water and a sleeping bat roost
pitch.stake: being caught by the tide; turning back means leaving the wonder unfound
pitch.ending_kind: time cave: each passage ends in a find carried home or a safe turn-back with a promise to return

maya.name: Maya
maya.want: to explore the echoing caves and find something wonderful before the tide turns
maya.voice: third person present; curious, careful, kind to wild animals; acts with her hands (traces carvings, copies names, sketches)

biscuit.name: Biscuit
biscuit.want: to follow every smell and stay close to Maya
biscuit.voice: no speech; tail, ears, nose, whines and one bark

aunt.name: Maya's aunt
aunt.want: Maya home safe when the tide turns

truth.statement: There is no single hidden answer: each mouth's sound has its own natural cause. The left hum is stone that carries sound (a crystal grotto and a singing chamber) and an old ship's bell rung by drips; the right drip is a trickle leading to a black underground lake and a hidden tide-pool; the middle whisper is only a draft of air, and that way leads to a bat roost and a smugglers' cache. Every cave floods when the tide returns.

maya_and_biscuit.text: Maya is exploring the sea caves under the lighthouse rocks with her dog Biscuit.

aunt_knows_plan.text: Maya's aunt knows Maya and Biscuit are exploring the cove until the tide turns.

tide_going_out.text: The tide is just pulling back from the sea caves.

three_openings.text: Three dark openings wait in the cliff, each breathing cool air.

left_hums.text: The left opening hums, warm and low.

right_drips.text: The right opening drips, slow and steady.

middle_whispers.text: Something almost whispers in the opening straight ahead.

one_hour_deadline.text: Maya has about an hour before the sea comes back and seals every cave mouth.
one_hour_deadline.implicit_plant: set at n_start; paid off at every turn-back and race-the-tide decision (la_grotto_app, la_bell_app, ra_pool_app, da_cache_app, da_cache_room)

maya_has_torch.text: Maya has a torch and has switched it on.

left_low_tunnel.text: The left passage narrows into a low tunnel that hums like one held note.

left_glow_rustle.text: Past a bend in the left tunnel a soft light glows and a rustle like wind through paper drifts back.
left_glow_rustle.implicit_plant: the paper-like rustle is never explained on any route

left_split.text: The humming tunnel splits: one wall glitters with specks, the other way the hum grows warmer like a murmuring voice.

quartz_wall.text: The glittering wall is studded with quartz that throws back the torchlight.

slope_to_cold_crack.text: The floor slopes down toward a narrow crack breathing cold air.

round_room_blue_crack.text: The slope opens into a small round room where a crack in the wall glows soft blue.

water_pooling.text: Cold water is pooling around Maya's boots, seeping in from deep in the rock.

through_crack.text: Maya and Biscuit squeezed sideways through the glowing crack.

crystal_grotto.text: Beyond the crack is a grotto of glowing blue crystals.

loose_crystal.text: One loose crystal wobbles in its socket at Maya's eye level.

humming_archway.text: A rounded archway deeper in the grotto hums with a low sound.

maya_has_crystal.text: Maya eased the loose glowing crystal free and carries it.

passage_to_lighthouse_stairs.text: The crystal's light shows a low passage curving upward toward the lighthouse above the cove.

door_behind_lighthouse.text: A narrow stone stair ends at a little wooden door tucked behind the old lighthouse.

evening_on_exit.text: It is evening when Maya comes out of the caves.

home_elsewhere.text: Maya's home is somewhere other than the cove ("everyone back home", "the rockpool club back home").

home_near_cove.text: Maya's home is by this stretch of sea ("somewhere under the sea near her home").

shell_walls.text: Beyond the archway the crystals thin and ribbed walls curve overhead like a shell, shaped as if built to carry sound.

ringing_chamber.text: A vast round chamber ahead layers every drip and footstep into something like music.

singing_chamber_found.text: Maya sang one note and the chamber sang it back: she has found the chamber that sings.

old_keeper_knew.text: Maya thinks only the lighthouse keepers of long ago ever knew about the singing chamber.

hum_is_ringing.text: The warm murmur is not wind but a low even ringing, like a bell struck far below.

chime_below.text: The ringing is a slow deep chime rising from a chamber below, where pale light shows something metal.

rope_ladder.text: An old rope ladder, left long ago, hangs down into the chamber below and holds firm; it is also the way back up.

ships_bell.text: A huge old ship's bell hangs green with age from a stone arch, rung softly by dripping water.

lost_ship_name.text: Letters cast in the bell's lip spell the name of a ship lost a hundred years ago.

lantern_and_rope.text: A rusted lantern and a coil of good rope sit on a dry ledge behind the bell; the rope is worth keeping.

maya_has_notebook.text: Maya carries a notebook in her pocket (checked at n_start).

name_copied.text: Maya copied the ship's name into her notebook.

took_lantern_rope.text: Maya took the lantern, which holds a candle stub, and the coil of rope.

climbed_out_by_rope.text: Maya and Biscuit climbed the rope ladder back up and came out of the cave mouth, the lantern on her wrist and the coil of rope over her shoulder.

back_at_mouth_safe.text: Maya and Biscuit got back out of the cave mouth safely as the sea returned.

plans_return.text: Maya means to come back on another low tide.

right_wet_passage.text: The right passage has wet black walls, a trickle of water leading deeper, and colder salty air.

right_split.text: The trickle leads to a split: hollow lapping one way, a briny smell from a low narrow side-tunnel the other.

lapping_from_ahead.text: The slow hollow lapping comes from down one branch and grows louder as Maya walks toward it.

pebbles_big_space.text: The passage floor turns to wet pebbles and the ceiling lifts out of torch reach.

black_lake.text: Beyond a rock shelf stretches black still water that vanishes into the dark.

lapping_is_biscuit.text: The lapping sound is the black lake itself nudging the shelf; Biscuit is only testing the cold edge of the water.

weedy_shelf.text: The rock shelf narrows above the lake, slick and green with weed.

gravel_shore.text: Maya climbed down to a shore of pale gravel beside the lake.

dark_shape_on_shore.text: Something long and dark rests half out of the water on the gravel.

rowboat.text: The dark shape is an old wooden rowboat, cracked but whole.

glowing_shallows.text: Further along the shore the shallow water glows faintly from beneath.

boat_floats.text: The rowboat has its oars lashed inside and floats steady once Maya tips out the rainwater.

crossed_lake.text: Maya rowed across the lake and climbed a stone chimney out into dune grass.

glowing_shells.text: Thousands of tiny pale shells glow on the bottom of the shallows, leading to a bright opening.

glowing_islet.text: The shells lead to a tiny islet of white sand under a shaft of sky; Maya takes a jar of shells and keeps the place secret.

briny_crawl.text: The briny side-tunnel is so tight Maya must crawl, with a paler light ahead.

clear_channel.text: A shallow channel of clear seawater runs along the floor toward a rounded chamber, under hanging weed.

weed_curtain.text: The channel ends at a curtain of hanging weed with bright watery light beyond.

channel_filling.text: The channel behind Maya is already filling with the tide.

hidden_tide_pool.text: Beyond the weed is a bright hidden tide-pool lit from high above, with anemones and silver fish.

orange_starfish.text: A rare cushion starfish glows deep orange in one corner of the pool.

crab_tracks_basin.text: Small crab tracks lead toward a deeper, darker basin.

starfish_sketched.text: Maya sketched the starfish in her notebook, left it where it clung, and took a photo of the pool.

rockpool_club.text: Maya knows a rockpool club back home who will want proof.

pale_thing_in_basin.text: Something smooth and pale is half-buried in the sand at the bottom of the green basin.

spiral_shell.text: Maya lifted out a perfect hand-sized spiral shell, pearled pink inside.

whisper_is_draft.text: The whispering echo is only a draft of air sighing over cold stone.

dark_split.text: The dark passage forks: papery squeaking and flutter one way, the creak of old wood and a glint of rusted iron the other.

hanging_shapes.text: Under a high ceiling hang hundreds of small folded shapes that twitch in their sleep.

bat_roost.text: The shapes are hundreds of sleeping bats roosting in a warm, earthy, vaulted chamber.

grey_light_gap.text: A faint circle of grey light shows through a narrow gap in the chamber roof.

shaft_beyond_roost.text: The grey light is a narrow shaft that may lead out, reached only by crossing beneath the roost.

never_touch_bats.text: The bats are wild animals that Maya knows she must never touch.

lighthouse_ranger.text: Maya's aunt, who keeps the lighthouse, is someone Maya can ask about the bats.

rock_staircase.text: Beneath the shaft, fallen rock forms a rough staircase up toward daylight.

old_carving.text: Halfway up, an old carved arrow and faded initials show someone climbed this chimney before.

mossy_funnel.text: The stair narrows into a mossy funnel smelling of grass; Maya boosts Biscuit up first.

meadow_skylight.text: The climb comes out through a hidden hole in the clifftop meadow above the lighthouse: a forgotten way into the caves, over a bat colony nobody has noticed in years.

museum.text: There is a museum Maya expects to tell about her find.

plank_door.text: Broken barrel staves litter the floor and a leaning grey plank door is wedged into a side-cave.

hidden_hollow.text: Behind the door is a dry hollow, walled off by hand long ago, with crates stacked inside.

smugglers_cache.text: The hollow is an old smugglers' cache, forgotten for a hundred years.

hollow_flooding.text: Creeping water already glistens on the hollow's floor.

marked_on_map.text: Maya fixed the cache's location in her memory to come back for it.

two_dry_boxes.text: Most crates have rotted, but two smaller boxes sit whole on a dry stone shelf.

compass_and_coins.text: One box holds a green-crusted brass compass; the other is heavy and rattles like coins.

carry_only_one.text: With the water rising, Maya can carry only one box out cleanly.

compass_points_way_out.text: The compass needle swings true, steady as the day it was made; Biscuit knows the way out.

compass_out.text: The compass led Maya and Biscuit out to the cave mouth just as the sea rushed in.

compass_finds_north.text: The compass needle still finds true north.

box_of_coins.text: The heavy box is full of blackened old silver coins stamped with strange faces.

coins_carried_out.text: Maya carried the whole box of coins out just ahead of the rising tide.

n_open.event: Maya and Biscuit reach three echoing cave mouths as the tide pulls back.

n_start.event: Maya checks the tide line, gives herself about an hour, switches on her torch, checks her notebook is in her pocket and picks a sound.

la_tunnel.event: The left passage narrows into a humming tunnel with a glow and a paper-like rustle ahead.

la_fork.event: The humming tunnel splits between a glittering wall and a warmer murmur; the tide presses her to choose.

la_glitter.event: Quartz studs the glittering wall; the floor slopes to a cold-breathing crack.

la_glitter2.event: The slope opens into a round room with a crack glowing blue.

la_grotto_app.event: Water pools at the glowing crack; squeeze through or turn back.

la_retreat_pool.event: Maya turns back through rising water and promises Biscuit they will return at the next low tide.

la_squeeze.event: Maya and Biscuit wriggle through the crack toward a brightening blue room.

la_grotto.event: The room is a crystal grotto with a loose crystal and a humming archway.

la_crystal_take.event: Maya takes the loose crystal; its light shows a passage curving upward toward the lighthouse.

la_crystal_out.event: The crystal lights a stair to a door behind the lighthouse; Maya steps out at evening with a real cave crystal to show everyone back home.

la_crystal_deeper.event: Through the archway, shell-like ribbed walls seem built to carry sound.

la_song_app.event: A vast round chamber layers every sound into music; Maya gathers courage.

la_song.event: Maya sings and the chamber sings back; she believes only the lighthouse keepers of long ago knew of it.

la_hum.event: The warm murmur is a ringing, like a bell far below.

la_hum2.event: The passage steepens toward a deep chime and a flash of metal in a lit chamber below.

la_bell_app.event: An old rope ladder hangs into the chamber; the tide-clock in her head warns her.

la_hum_back.event: Maya decides the chime can wait and climbs back to the mouth, safe, already planning a return.

la_bell.event: At the bottom hangs a huge old ship's bell rung by drips.

la_bell2.event: The bell carries the name of a ship lost a hundred years ago; a lantern and rope sit behind it.

la_bell3.event: Maya copies the name into her notebook and gathers the lantern and rope.

la_bell4.event: Maya and Biscuit climb the rope ladder out at gold evening light, lantern on her wrist and rope on her shoulder, the ship's name safe, imagining the town hearing about the lost ship near her home.

ra_drip.event: The right passage is wet, cold and salty, with a trickle leading deeper.

ra_fork.event: The trickle reaches a split: hollow lapping one way, a briny side-tunnel the other.

ra_lake_way.event: The lapping grows louder over wet pebbles as the ceiling lifts away.

ra_lake2.event: A rock shelf edges a black lake; the lapping is the lake itself, and Biscuit tests the cold edge.

ra_lake_app.event: The shelf narrows and turns weed-slick above the lake; climb down or back off.

ra_lake_back.event: Maya coaxes Biscuit back off the shelf and retraces the passage to the mouth, safe.

ra_descend.event: Maya climbs down to a gravel shore where something dark lies half out of the water.

ra_lakeshore.event: The shape is an old rowboat; further along, the shallows glow.

ra_boat.event: The rowboat floats with its oars inside; Biscuit hops in.

ra_row.event: Maya rows across the lake and climbs a chimney out into dune grass.

ra_wade.event: Glowing shells carpet the shallows and lead toward a bright opening.

ra_islet.event: The shells lead to a sunlit islet; Maya pockets a few shells and keeps the place secret.

ra_pool_way.event: Maya crawls through the tight briny side-tunnel toward a paler light.

ra_pool2.event: The tunnel widens; a clear seawater channel runs under hanging weed toward a chamber.

ra_pool_app.event: A weed curtain glows ahead while the channel behind fills with tide.

ra_pool_back.event: Maya hurries back through the filling channel and bursts out as the sea pours in, planning to try again.

ra_pool_enter.event: Beyond the weed lies a bright hidden tide-pool full of life.

ra_pool_chamber.event: A rare orange cushion starfish glows; crab tracks lead to a darker basin.

ra_starfish.event: Maya sketches the starfish, leaves it in place and looks over the pool one last time.

ra_starfish2.event: Maya leaves with the sketches the rockpool club back home will need to see.

ra_pool_deep.event: Something pale gleams half-buried in the green basin; Maya reaches in.

ra_pool_deep2.event: Maya lifts out a great spiral shell and carries it into daylight.

da_dark.event: Maya goes down the darkest passage; the whisper is only a draft.

da_fork.event: The passage forks between squeaking flutter and creaking wood with rusted iron.

da_bat_way.event: Hundreds of small folded shapes hang from a high ceiling.

da_bat2.event: The shapes are sleeping bats; grey light shows through the roof.

da_bat_app.event: The grey light is a shaft reached only by crossing under the roost; bats must never be touched.

da_bat_back.event: Maya backs away and leaves the bats sleeping, safe, and means to ask her aunt about them.

da_bat_enter.event: Maya crosses quietly under the roost; fallen rock forms a stair to the light.

da_roost.event: Halfway up the stair an old carved arrow and initials show someone climbed before.

da_roost2.event: The stair narrows into a mossy funnel; Maya boosts Biscuit up.

da_skylight.event: Maya climbs out into the clifftop meadow through a forgotten way into the caves, over a bat colony, and imagines the museum's reaction.

da_cache_way.event: Barrel staves and a leaning plank door sit where the wood creaks.

da_cache2.event: Behind the door is a hand-walled dry hollow with stacked crates.

da_cache_app.event: It is a forgotten smugglers' cache, and tide water is creeping in.

da_cache_back.event: Maya marks the cache in her memory and beats the tide out, planning to return.

da_cache_enter.event: Most crates are rotten; two dry boxes sit whole on a shelf.

da_cache_room.event: One box holds a brass compass, the other rattles with coins; she can carry only one.

da_compass.event: The compass needle swings true; Biscuit knows the way out and they hurry ahead of the tide.

da_compass2.event: Biscuit leads them out as the sea rushes in; the compass needle still finds true north.

da_coins.event: The heavy box holds old silver coins; Maya carries the whole box.

da_coins2.event: Maya lugs the box out ahead of the tide, imagining the museum and her name as the finder of the smugglers' hoard.

c_right.cost: hidden: leads to water routes, the slickest footing in the book

c_down.intent: follow the whisper into the darkest passage
c_down.cost: hidden: the darkest way; wild animals and a flooding cache

c_glitter.cost: leads to a crack that is filling with water

c_hum.cost: leads to a ladder descent against the tide

c_squeeze.intent: squeeze through before the water rises
c_squeeze.cost: risk of being caught by the rising water

c_retreat.intent: turn back while the way is dry
c_retreat.cost: gives up the glow; safe exit

c_take.intent: take the loose crystal and follow its light
c_take.cost: ends the exploration with one keepsake

c_deeper.cost: leaves the crystal behind for a bigger wonder

c_la_chime.intent: climb down toward the chiming light

c_bell.intent: climb down the old ladder despite the tide
c_bell.cost: time against the tide; an old ladder

c_humback.cost: gives up the chime; safe exit

c_la_bell3.intent: read the name and look behind the bell

c_la_bell4.intent: take the lantern and rope and head out

c_lake.intent: go toward the big, still water
c_lake.cost: leads to a weed-slick shelf over a cold lake

c_pool.cost: a crawl through a channel the tide will fill

c_descend.cost: risk of a fall into cold water

c_lakeback.cost: gives up the lake; safe exit

c_boat.intent: examine the boat and row out

c_wade.cost: wet feet; leaves the boat behind

c_enter.intent: push through the weed while the channel fills

c_poolback.intent: hurry back before the channel fills
c_poolback.cost: gives up the light beyond; safe exit

c_star.intent: study the starfish and leave it be
c_star.cost: a find you can only draw, not keep

c_deep.intent: follow the crab tracks into the dark basin

c_ra_sketch.intent: finish the sketch and slip out

c_bat.cost: leads to a roost of wild animals

c_cache.cost: leads to a cache in a flooding hollow

c_batback.cost: gives up the way out above; the kind choice

c_cacheenter.intent: step in for a quick look

c_cacheback.intent: leave the cache and beat the tide
c_cacheback.cost: gives up the crates; safe exit

c_compass.intent: take the light compass that can guide them

c_coins.intent: take the heavy box of coins
c_coins.cost: a slow, heavy carry with the tide rising

la_retreat_pool.gift: the glowing crack is still waiting: a reason to come back at the next low tide

la_crystal_out.gift: a real glowing cave crystal and a hidden stair to the lighthouse

la_song.gift: the chamber that sings back, and a note Maya hums all the way home

la_hum_back.gift: the unseen chime below, kept for a safer day

la_bell4.gift: the name of a lost ship whose bell still rings, plus the lantern and rope

ra_lake_back.gift: the black lake left for another day

ra_row.gift: a crossing of the hidden lake and a secret chimney into the dunes

ra_islet.gift: a jar of glowing shells and a secret islet

ra_pool_back.gift: the bright light behind the weed curtain, still unseen

ra_starfish2.gift: sketches of a rare starfish, left alive where it clings

ra_pool_deep2.gift: the finest shell Maya has ever found

da_bat_back.gift: the kind choice, and a question to ask about the roost waking at night

da_skylight.gift: a secret way into the caves and a hidden bat colony

da_cache_back.gift: a smugglers' cache marked on the map for a drier day

da_compass2.gift: a working smuggler's compass a century old

da_coins2.gift: a box of old smugglers' coins for the museum

threads_note: The book declares no variables, so the plan has no threads. Implicit plant-like setups found while reading are recorded as facts with implicit_plant set.

continuity_notes: PLAIN CONTRADICTION (same route c_right > c_lake > c_ra_pebbles): ra_fork and ra_lake_way establish a hollow lapping heard from down the branch and growing louder with each step (lapping_from_ahead); ra_lake2 then says 'The lapping sound, it turns out, is only Biscuit's paw' (lapping_is_biscuit). The sound was heard before Biscuit reached the water.

continuity_notes: SOFT, cross-route: home_elsewhere vs home_near_cove. la_crystal_out ('show everyone back home') and ra_starfish2 ('the rockpool club back home') place Maya's home away from the cove; la_bell4 ('somewhere under the sea near her home') places it by the cove. No single route carries both, so no reader meets the clash.

continuity_notes: SOFT, same route (c_cache > c_compass > c_da_out): da_compass says the needle points 'the quickest way back to the cave mouth'; da_compass2 says it is 'still finding true north'. Compatible only if the way out lies due north.

continuity_notes: SOFT: n_open establishes Maya's aunt as the lighthouse keeper; la_song has Maya think 'only the old lighthouse keeper ever knew' of the chamber, and da_bat_back introduces 'the lighthouse ranger' as if known. Neither is introduced or tied to the aunt.

continuity_notes: SOFT, same route (c_bat ... c_da_push): da_roost shows carved initials proving someone climbed the chimney before; da_skylight calls it 'a whole secret way into the caves' with bats 'nobody else ever knew' about.

continuity_notes: SOFT, logic: la_bell4 has Maya climb 'the good rope' back up, though she came down a rope ladder that held firm and a loose coil cannot anchor itself at the top; the lantern is 'lit' with nothing established to light it.
continuity_notes: UNPAID SETUP: la_tunnel's rustle 'like wind through paper' is never explained on any route (left_glow_rustle).

continuity_notes: Props introduced in passing by possessive, recorded as established where first named: notebook (la_bell3, ra_starfish), map (da_cache_back), a camera or phone for the photo (ra_starfish, not recorded as a fact), a jar (ra_islet).

continuity_notes: WP-0.4 (2026-11-21): the plain contradictions above (lapping, compass, keeper/ranger, carved initials, rope/lantern, map, photo, jar, passage direction) were fixed in the book; the soft cross-route home_elsewhere vs home_near_cove item and the unexplained rustle were left as recorded, as they are taste items on no single route.
